principles: Separate product name from model number/SKU and sales region.
Separate frequency compatibility from carrier official operation guarantee.
Separate official specification verification from hands-on testing.
For carrier/MVNO procedures, verify current official instructions and display confirmation date.
Cover failure paths and blocking conditions, not only normal procedures.
Do not prioritize affiliate conversion during the AdSense/search growth stage.
For imported devices, separate radio-band compatibility, VoLTE/IMS interoperability, carrier operation confirmation, and Japanese technical conformity (Giteki).
Do not generalize the 90-day radio-equipment exception beyond its statutory inbound-device conditions.
For eSIM troubleshooting, separate transfer, reissue, profile deletion, and contract cancellation.
